newsitem.title: USA: Enhance says raises stake in Singer Asset.
newsitem.headline: Enhance says raises stake in Singer Asset.

text.p: Enhance Financial Services Group Inc said Monday it bought an additional 37.5 percent of Singer Asset Finance Co LLC, raising Enhance's ownership to 87.5 percent.
Singer, based in West Palm Beach, Fla., originates, services, and securitizes state lottery prizes and other consumer receivables.
Singer was formed as a joint venture in October 1995, with Enhance as a 50 percent investor.
Enhance said it purchased its additional interest in Singer Asset with newly issued Enhance common shares.
An Enhance spokesperson said the shares were purchased from a private investor. The spokesperson declined to name the investor.
Enhance said it anticipates that the additional investment in Singer will have a net positive impact on 1997 and 1998 earnings per share.
Enhance will have operating control of Singer Asset and will report its interest on a consolidated basis.
